$comment: Initial performance/quality budget for bluntly.ph — a regression guardrail, not product truth.
The repository had no approved frontend budget before 2026-09-17 (docs/PRODUCTION.md budgets
database connections only), so these start from the web-quality-skills guardrails the owner
named, and are checked against the MEDIAN of N Lighthouse runs, never a single run.
Lab values only. Core Web Vitals pass/fail is a FIELD (p75) judgement; a lab LCP under 2.5 s does
not prove users are fast, and TBT is a responsiveness proxy, not INP.
Severity: error = fails `--assert`; warn = reported, never fails.
